Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 5, Verse 8

“The one who knows the truth, disciplined, thinks: I do nothing at all — while seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, eating, moving, sleeping, and breathing.”

A deliberately mundane list. Krishna picks the least glamorous human activities to make his point, since these are precisely the ones nobody could claim to have renounced.
